slides.title: Things I stopped doing and my house got cleaner (I'm serious)
I stopped folding everything
slides.body: Undies, socks and pajamas get tossed in bins. Folding was the step that kept laundry in the basket.

slides.title: I stopped waiting for a free day
slides.body: That day never came. Ten minutes after dinner beats a dream Saturday that never happens.

slides.title: I stopped cleaning in order
slides.body: Top to bottom, left to right. Nope. I start where it bugs me most. Starting is the hard part.

slides.title: I stopped hiding the tools
slides.body: The spray and cloth live on the counter now. If I can see it, I use it.

slides.title: I stopped all-or-nothing
slides.body: Half the dishes still counts. Half a load of laundry still counts. Partial is progress.

slides.title: My house got cleaner the day I stopped cleaning like someone else's brain.
